Name: Waterfall Farm (CP)
Author: Akayotic18
Description:
Remake of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1122]Ali's Foraging Map [/url]by strawberrymilk95, I started from the base foraging map and rebuilt it to add new features! I used waterfall tilesheets from Maleha, which you can download [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/waterfall-tilesheet-w-animation.132102/page-2]here[/url]﻿. But they're already included in the download folder too, for easier use! Just put this mod into your mods folder along with the required [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] mod. Replaces the default Forest Farm map.

Edit: Now added a config file, so set the config to "MFS" for the version of this map that has more farming space and less grass. Also updated said map to have even more farm space! Enjoy! <3

Edit 2: Apologies for not including this originally, but there are in fact 2 hidden entrances into the swimming pond area in the bottom right corner of the map! One of them is directly to the left of the main entrance and the other is on the way left side of the forest area surrounding the swimming hole, you just have to use a pickaxe/axe to clear the debris to find them. Going through either of these entrances allows you to keep your regular clothes, movement speed, and to use your tools and everything like normal, hope this helps some!!
